spark.js and spark.wasm are built from Firo's Spark library and what it is compiled with
(spark/build.sh, pinned in spark/spark.lock.json). Each keeps its own licence, here:

  sparkmobile-LICENSE            sparkmobile (Firo), MIT
  sparkmobile_enkrypt-LICENSE    sparkmobile, enkrypt fork (Firo), MIT
  flutter_libsparkmobile-LICENSE flutter_libsparkmobile (Cypher Stack), MIT
  bitcoin-core-COPYING           code from Bitcoin Core, MIT
  secp256k1-COPYING              libsecp256k1, MIT
  ctaes-COPYING                  ctaes, MIT
  musl-COPYRIGHT                 musl libc, MIT
  llvm-libcxx-LICENSE.txt        LLVM libc++, Apache-2.0 with LLVM Exceptions
  emscripten-LICENSE             Emscripten runtime, MIT / University of Illinois NCSA
